children: Quoin Pharmaceuticals announced FDA Rare Pediatric Disease designation for QRX003 in Peeling Skin Syndrome.
FDA granted Rare Pediatric Disease designation for QRX003 for Peeling Skin Syndrome, marking the second RPD for the asset.
If an NDA for QRX003 is approved for PSS, Quoin may receive a tradable Priority Review Voucher, offering regulatory/financial value.
Quoin expects to initiate a Phase 2 study in 2H 2026, planning to enroll up to 12 pediatric and adult PSS patients in the U.S. and Europe.
There are currently no approved treatments for Peeling Skin Syndrome, underscoring the unmet medical need QRX003 aims to address.
